title: Tighten Schedule WebView draft trust
summary: Improve Schedule tab staged-draft clarity, launch-window trust, bulk-action feedback, watch-folder scanning, duplicate-submit protection, and responsive editor behavior while leaving preview diff expansion out of scope.
reason: The Schedule UI audit found that saved/current evidence can be confused with unsaved draft edits, bulk changes lack specific feedback, in-flight preview/save controls can be reused, current-window evidence is too prose-heavy, and the editor/watch-folder surfaces need clearer scan and responsive behavior.
behavior_before: Schedule edits were staged locally and safely previewed/saved through backend routes, but saved evidence panels did not clearly distinguish unsaved drafts, bulk actions had generic feedback, Load Current preserved the day clipboard, in-flight commands were not globally disabled, watch-folder evidence was dense prose, and partial allowed windows used warning-colored rows.
behavior_after: Schedule edits expose explicit staged-draft summaries and saved/current labels, bulk actions report exact staged totals, Load Current clears copy/paste state, preview/save disables related controls while pending, weekly/current-window and watch-folder evidence is easier to scan, and schedule-specific status colors separate allowed, review, blocked, current, and saved states.
